facts.text: The hotel is on La Croisette Boulevard on the French Riviera.
facts.excerpt: Advantageously positioned on the French Riviera's La Croisette Boulevard, the Carlton Cannes, a Regent hotel, is a ravishing emblem of the Côte d'Azur.

facts.text: Nice Cote d'Azur Airport is 30 minutes by car from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport is 30 minutes by car from the hotel.

facts.text: An airport transfer can be arranged on request.

facts.text: Interior designer Tristan Auer designed the rooms to blend Belle Epoque charm with modern comfort.
